name: WMUIAvatarStack
description: Overlapping circular avatars with per-avatar status dots and a +N overflow bubble. Built from plain views and negative margins, so it needs no drawing library and runs everywhere.

dataset.name: dataset
dataset.description: Members to render. Each row may carry a name, an imageUrl and a status. Example: [{name: 'Ada', imageUrl: '...', status: 'online'}]

maxVisible.name: maxVisible
maxVisible.description: How many avatars render before the rest collapse into a +N bubble. The overflow count comes from the data. Default: 4

avatarSize.name: avatarSize
avatarSize.description: Avatar diameter in pixels. The status dot and initials scale with it. Default: 44

overlap.name: overlap
overlap.description: Pixels each avatar overlaps the one before it. Default: 14

borderColor.name: borderColor
borderColor.description: Ring drawn around each avatar so overlapping edges stay separated. Default: #FFFFFF

nameField.name: nameField
nameField.description: Row field holding the display name. Its first letter is the initials fallback. Default: name

imageField.name: imageField
imageField.description: Row field holding the avatar image URL. Default: imageUrl

statusField.name: statusField
statusField.description: Row field holding the presence state: online, away or offline. Default: status

showStatus.name: showStatus
showStatus.description: Whether to draw the presence dot on each avatar. Default: true

onMemberSelect.name: onMemberSelect
onMemberSelect.description: Fires with the member whose avatar was tapped. The overflow bubble is not tappable.
